role: The tripwire (id 132): a thin string across a hook-to-hook line; it arms when an entity stands in it, tells the hooks, and breaks when its floor support goes.

members.name: getRenderBlockPass
members.note: Pass 1 from the generated table; the mesh scenes record the wire in pass 1; render-only: every caller is the client renderer (RenderBlocks, RenderItem, ItemRenderer, RenderGlobal's outline, the item icon and colour hooks); row recordings draw no frames

members.name: onNeighborBlockChange
members.note: drops itself when the solid-top support under it changes

members.name: onBlockAdded
members.note: sets the support bit and runs the hook update (place.c:place_tripwire_on_added covers the item-placement path)

members.name: breakBlock
members.note: func_150138_a(meta | 1): both runs' facing hooks run func_150136_a inside the write, before the cell's metadata is replaced (blockcb.c:bwl_on_broken, added by lane/idxblocks; the index had cited it but it was missing).

members.name: onBlockHarvested
members.note: Shears set bit 8 (disarmed) with flag 4 before the wire goes, so the hooks read it disarmed (dig.c:try_harvest_block, added by lane/idxblocks).

members.name: func_150138_a
members.note: walks both directions to the hooks and runs their state machine

members.name: onEntityCollidedWithBlock
members.note: collide.c answers COLLIDE_EFFECT_PLATE for id 132, and the world's plate hook (installed on the replay's worlds for every phase, so the player's own moves reach it) runs func_150140_e while the wire is not tripped. Arrows reach it through projectile.c:arrow_block_collisions.

members.name: updateTick
members.note: servertick.c dispatches 132 to the plate hook; it re-checks while tripped.

members.name: func_150140_e
members.note: The wire's box against every entity but the bat, the tripped bit (flag 3), func_150138_a to the hooks, and the 10-tick re-check while occupied. The box is the state's setBlockBoundsBasedOnState bounds; Java's is whatever the shared Block last held (every ray and render sets it), which for a resting wire holds the same entities in the recorded scene. details-blocks-s1 walks across a hooked wire both ways. The count takes entities already dead this tick, as the chunk lists do (sr_box_count; plate-dead-s1).

members.name: func_150139_a
members.note: RenderBlocks' arm test (render_blocks3.c:tripwire_side); the mesh scenes draw the wire's arms; render-only: every caller is the client renderer (RenderBlocks, RenderItem, ItemRenderer, RenderGlobal's outline, the item icon and colour hooks); row recordings draw no frames

notes: The hook half of the pair is ported (BlockTripWireHook's record). The wire's own detection (onEntityCollidedWithBlock, updateTick, func_150140_e) is serverreplay.c's sr_tripwire_check, on the box of the wire's own metadata: the oracle's tripwire pin (SPEC.md, Oracle.tripwireBounds) makes Java read the same box instead of the singleton's last bounds. The jungle pyramid's tripwires are placed by structure generation (blockcb.c:738 notes they matter to state). lane/idxblocks: idx-blocks-s1 walks through an attached line and cuts it with shears; the seven metadata writes of the cut match in order.
